description: List Wbs Code Filters for a given project

items.description: A work breakdown structure code filter.

id.description: Composite identifier for this filter in the pattern '{segment_id}-{tier_depth}' (e.g. '500-1' for tier 2 of segment 500). Use as the value of the filters[id] query parameter in GET .../codes/filter...

label.description: Translated human-readable label for this filter, describing the segment and tier level (e.g. "Cost Code Tier 1", "Cost Type Tier 1"). Display to users in filter selection dropdowns.
